q1.audio.1.1.textEn: A. The cook is slicing a pie on a board.
q1.audio.1.1.textZh: A. 厨师正在案板上切馅饼。

q1.audio.2.1.textEn: B. Some plates are being dried with a cloth.
q1.audio.2.1.textZh: B. 有人正在用布擦干一些盘子。

q1.audio.3.1.textEn: C. Steam is rising from a pan on the stove.
q1.audio.3.1.textZh: C. 蒸汽正从炉灶上的锅里升起。
q1.audio.3.1.noteZh: rise from 表示从某处升起，on the stove 指锅在炉灶上。

q1.audio.4.1.textEn: D. A whisk is being hung from a hook.
q1.audio.4.1.textZh: D. 有人正在把打蛋器挂到钩子上。

q7.audio.1.1.textEn: Who will spearhead the charity campaign?
q7.audio.1.1.textZh: 谁将牵头负责这次慈善活动？
q7.audio.1.1.noteZh: spearhead 在这里是动词，表示带头推动。

q7.audio.2.1.textEn: A. Lena offered to lead it.
q7.audio.2.1.textZh: A. 莉娜主动提出带领这项活动。

q7.audio.4.1.textEn: C. It has a bright spear-shaped logo.
q7.audio.4.1.textZh: C. 它有一个醒目的矛形标志。

3-group-1.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 32 through 34 refer to the following conversation.
3-group-1.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 32 至 34 题根据以下对话作答。

3-group-1.audio.2.1.textEn: Our new subsidiary needs a versatile reception system.
3-group-1.audio.2.1.textZh: 我们的新子公司需要一套多功能接待系统。

3-group-1.audio.2.2.textEn: The sales representative keeps trying to tout the premium package, but most of its features are peripheral to what we need.
3-group-1.audio.2.2.textZh: 销售代表一再推销高级套餐，但其中大部分功能和我们的实际需求关系不大。
3-group-1.audio.2.2.noteZh: tout 是大力推销；peripheral to 表示与主要需求关系不大。

3-group-1.audio.3.2.textEn: Ease of use should be the main criterion.
3-group-1.audio.3.2.textZh: 易用性应该是主要标准。

3-group-1.audio.3.3.textEn: The basic package lets visitors register and prints badges without extra equipment.
3-group-1.audio.3.3.textZh: 基础套餐可以让访客登记并打印访客证，无需额外设备。

3-group-1.audio.4.2.textEn: Still, I do not want to incur an installation fee we have overlooked.
3-group-1.audio.4.2.textZh: 不过，我不想因为疏忽而多付安装费。

3-group-1.audio.5.1.textEn: I will request a written quotation that includes setup and training.
3-group-1.audio.5.1.textZh: 我会索取一份包含安装和培训的书面报价。

3-group-1.audio.5.2.textEn: Then we can compare the total costs before signing anything.
3-group-1.audio.5.2.textZh: 这样签约之前就能比较总费用。

q32.stem.1.textZh: 两位说话者在选购什么？

4-group-1.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 71 through 73 refer to the following talk.
4-group-1.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 71 至 73 题根据以下讲话作答。

4-group-1.audio.2.1.textEn: Good afternoon, and welcome to the inaugural session of the Harbor Arts Forum.
4-group-1.audio.2.1.textZh: 下午好，欢迎参加港湾艺术论坛的首场活动。

4-group-1.audio.2.2.textEn: Our ebullient host, Elena Ruiz, will introduce the speakers at two.
4-group-1.audio.2.2.textZh: 我们热情洋溢的主持人埃莱娜·鲁伊斯将在两点介绍演讲嘉宾。

4-group-1.audio.2.3.textEn: The main presentation explores the intrinsic value of local arts, rather than treating attendance figures as the only measure of success.
4-group-1.audio.2.3.textZh: 主旨演讲将探讨本地艺术本身的价值，而不把出席人数当作衡量成功的唯一标准。
4-group-1.audio.2.3.noteZh: intrinsic value 指事物本身的价值。

4-group-1.audio.2.4.textEn: We hope to elicit candid suggestions from the audience, so please use the cards on your seats to submit questions.
4-group-1.audio.2.4.textZh: 我们希望听到各位坦诚的建议，请用座位上的卡片提交问题。

4-group-1.audio.2.5.textEn: A volunteer will collect them during the break.
4-group-1.audio.2.5.textZh: 休息期间会有志愿者收取卡片。

4-group-1.audio.2.6.textEn: Although our original speaker is unavailable, her substitute has agreed to lead the discussion.
4-group-1.audio.2.6.textZh: 原定演讲嘉宾无法出席，接替她的嘉宾已同意主持讨论。

4-group-1.audio.2.7.textEn: The workshop will culminate in a short planning session at four, when participants can propose projects for next year.
4-group-1.audio.2.7.textZh: 研讨会最后会在四点安排一场简短的规划会，届时与会者可以提出明年的项目建议。

q71.stem.1.textEn: What is the event mainly about?
q71.stem.1.textZh: 这场活动主要涉及什么？

q101.stem.1.textEn: The monetary award will be divided _____ among the three winning teams.
q101.stem.1.textZh: 奖金将在三支获胜队伍之间 _____ 分配。

6-passage-group-1.passage.1.2.textZh: 发件人：米拉·陈，访客服务部

6-passage-group-1.passage.1.6.textEn: Our inaugural design exhibition opens next Friday.
6-passage-group-1.passage.1.6.textZh: 我们的首届设计展将于下周五开幕。

6-passage-group-1.passage.1.7.textEn: The entrance facade has been restored, and a local artisan has donated an exquisite ornament for the reception desk.
6-passage-group-1.passage.1.7.textZh: 入口的外立面已经修复，一位当地工匠还捐赠了一件精美的饰品，供接待台陈设。

6-passage-group-1.passage.1.8.textEn: The display will remain in place _____ (131) the end of the month.
6-passage-group-1.passage.1.8.textZh: 展品将一直陈列在原处 _____（131）本月底。

6-passage-group-1.passage.1.9.textEn: Please do not attach labels directly to its surface, as adhesive can inflict permanent damage.
6-passage-group-1.passage.1.9.textZh: 请勿把标签直接贴在展品表面，因为黏合剂可能造成永久损伤。

6-passage-group-1.passage.1.10.textEn: A distinguished designer will give a short talk.
6-passage-group-1.passage.1.10.textZh: 一位知名设计师将发表简短讲话。

6-passage-group-1.passage.1.11.textEn: To avoid a stampede when the doors open, we will admit visitors in small groups.
6-passage-group-1.passage.1.11.textZh: 为避免开门时人群蜂拥而入，我们将让参观者分小批入场。

6-passage-group-1.passage.1.12.textEn: Tickets _____ (132) at the east entrance by two volunteers.
6-passage-group-1.passage.1.12.textZh: 门票将由两名志愿者在东门 _____（132）。

6-passage-group-1.passage.1.13.textEn: **[1]** (133) Guests waiting outside can then move indoors without blocking the main doorway.
6-passage-group-1.passage.1.13.textZh: [1]（133）这样，在外等候的来宾就能进入室内，不会堵住主入口。

6-passage-group-1.passage.1.14.textEn: Please _____ (134) any access problems by Wednesday.
6-passage-group-1.passage.1.14.textZh: 请在周三前 _____（134）任何出入方面的问题。

6-passage-group-1.passage.1.15.textEn: We want an auspicious opening, but punctuality must not come at the expense of visitor safety.
6-passage-group-1.passage.1.15.textZh: 我们希望开幕顺利，但不能为了准时而牺牲参观者的安全。

q131.stem.1.textZh: 哪个单词最适合填入第 131 题的空格？

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.3.textEn: The restored cinema hosts The Last Signal on November 7.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.3.textZh: 翻修后的影院将于 11 月 7 日放映《最后的信号》。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.4.textEn: The story follows a fugitive attempting to clear her name; organizers describe it as suspense rather than a morbid account of violence.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.4.textZh: 影片讲述一名在逃女子试图洗清冤屈的故事，主办方称这是一部悬疑片，而非渲染暴力的猎奇故事。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.5.textEn: The screening begins at 7 p.m., followed by a discussion with the director.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.5.textZh: 影片将于晚上 7 点开始放映，随后安排与导演交流。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.6.textEn: Cameras are prohibited during the film.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.6.textZh: 放映期间禁止使用相机。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.7.textEn: An accredited paparazzo or other press photographer may work only in the lobby and must obtain permission before photographing guests.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.7.textZh: 持有采访证的狗仔或其他新闻摄影师只能在大厅工作，拍摄来宾前必须获得许可。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.8.textEn: The event aims to resurrect interest in local filmmaking.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.8.textZh: 活动旨在重新激发人们对本地电影创作的兴趣。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.9.textEn: The director's next project is a sequel, but no release date has been announced.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.9.textZh: 导演的下一个项目是这部电影的续集，但上映日期尚未公布。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.10.textEn: Bookings cost $18 and include the discussion.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.10.textZh: 预订票价为 18 美元，包含交流环节。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.11.textZh: 学生出示证件后可享 12 美元票价。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.12.textEn: Uncollected tickets are released fifteen minutes before the film.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.12.textZh: 未领取的门票将在开场前 15 分钟重新发售。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.13.textEn: The evening celebrates storytelling, not the hedonistic lifestyle depicted by some of its characters.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.13.textZh: 当晚活动旨在庆祝讲故事的艺术，而非推崇片中某些角色的享乐主义生活方式。

q147.stem.1.textEn: What is included in the admission price?

1.source:
C
Steam is visibly rising from the left-hand pan. No pie, plate drying, or hanging whisk is shown.
1.textZh: 选 C。原图左侧炉灶上的锅正冒蒸汽。画面中没有切馅饼、擦盘子或悬挂打蛋器的动作。rise from 表示「从……升起」，留意动作和位置是否同时符合画面。

7.source:
A
The question asks for a leader; Lena is identified as that person. The location and logo do not answer who.
7.textZh: 选 A。Who 问的是人，Lena offered to lead it 用「莉娜主动请缨」间接给出了人选。B 回答地点，C 只描述标志。offer to do 表示主动提出做某事。

32.source:
B
Visitor registration and badge printing identify a reception system; none of the other purchases is discussed.
32.textZh: 选 B。访客登记和打印访客证都是接待系统的功能，且开头直接提到 reception system。对话没有讨论购买送货车、聘请广告代理公司或选择会议嘉宾。

71.source:
D
The main presentation and project planning concern local arts. Aviation, banking, and cooking are not topics.
71.textZh: 选 D。主旨演讲讨论本地艺术本身的价值，最后还会为来年的相关项目做规划。机场开发、银行业务及食品制作均未提及。mainly about 考查的是全篇主题。

101.source:
D
The verb phrase will be divided requires an adverb of manner; equally fits. Equal is an adjective, equality a noun, and equalize a verb.
101.textZh: 选 D。equally 是方式副词，修饰 will be divided，说明奖金如何分配。equality 是名词，equalize 是动词，equal 在这里是形容词，均不适合。divide … among … 表示「在……之间分配」。

131.source:
C
Until expresses the end of the display period. The other prepositions do not specify a time endpoint.
131.textZh: 选 C。until the end of the month 表示持续到月底，与 will remain 搭配说明陈列何时结束。except 表示排除，among 表示在群体中，onto 表示移动到表面，均无法表达这里的时间终点。

147.source:
D
The booking includes the screening and discussion. No script or private session is offered; the sequel has no release date.
147.textZh: 选 D。原文明确说票价包含交流环节。私人摄影和印刷版剧本均未列入；续集连上映日期都未公布。include 表示「包含」，题干用 is included in 改述。
